title: Connect Grok Bot/Cursor to Genie One with the Databricks Genie plugin
body: The Databricks Genie plugin connects Grok Bot/Cursor to the Genie One MCP, so users can ask questions about their data from Grok Bot/Cursor. A Cursor team admin publishes the plugin for the team, and each user connects by signing in with their Databricks account. See [Databricks Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Bot/Cursor](/aws/en/agents/mcp-tools/genie-mcp#genie-plugins).
